term check (each part is fitted together with free curves that stand in for the terms it leaves out):
- the terms that mix inputs, (params[1] * P * np.sin(params[2] * t)) + (params[3] * P * np.cos(params[2] * t)): RIGHT, keep this part as it is
- the terms in t alone, (params[6] * t * np.exp(-params[7] * t)) + (params[8] * np.sqrt(t)): NOT right, change this part
- the terms in P alone, (params[0] * np.sqrt(P)) + (params[4] * P) + (params[5] * P ** 2): RIGHT, keep this part as it is
